messages:
sylvie: Draft ready — Lacuna Health case study is in the drive and needs legal + customer OK by EOD Fri. Key numbers included: 3x latency improvement, ~40% inference cost reduction. Draft: https://drive.redwood.dev/lacuna-case-draft
jamal: Can we lock the CTO interview? They offered next Tue morning PT. I can do 10am PT if that works for product and marketing.
olivia: I uploaded v2 with a tighter headline and a stronger benchmark narrative. Candidate quote: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by about 40% while keeping p95 under 120ms." Thinking we should avoid exact dollar figures.
kevin: Quick Q on routing — once published, where do inbound leads from the case study go? Sales needs them funneled to a dedicated queue and tagged for renewals.
marta: Publishing plan idea: 1) long-form blog (customer narrative + bench), 2) 30m customer-led webinar (tech + ROI), 3) two short social posts and an email blast to trial users. Webinar ask: 2 customer slides + 5m demo.
legal-team: Review notes: we need a signed media release before publishing; remove any PHI from quotes/metrics. For quotes, prefer wording like "about 40%" instead of symbols like "~40%". We'll review and aim to return comments by EOD tomorrow.
olivia: Got it, changed the quote to plain language and removed an internal latency sample that might be PII-adjacent. New excerpt: 
```
"Redwood reduced our inference costs by about 40% while maintaining a p95 latency under 120ms, which enabled us to ship feature X faster."
```
kevin: I'll set up SFDC stuff now — plan: campaign = CaseStudy_Lacuna_2027, queue = CaseStudy_Inbound, tag = cs_lacuna_2027. Are we OK making a form gated asset for lead capture?
marta: Yes, gated asset + nurture sequence. Also short un-gated summary for social. Need marketing ops help on the form and tracking pixels.
legal-team: Quick follow-up after scanning the draft: remove one sentence referencing patient IDs (redlined). Also confirm we have explicit customer approval for webinar participation and for using slide images. Once that's confirmed we can approve.
sylvie: I've pinged Lacuna legal and their marketing lead for the release form and slide permissions — should hear back by tomorrow afternoon. Jamal — can you confirm the 10am PT interview slot?
jamal: Confirmed with Lacuna CTO for Tue 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and attach the suggested interview guide.
legal-team: Approved with one small edit: change "cut our inference cost by ~40%" -> "reduced inference costs by about 40%" (copy updated). Media release from Lacuna required before publish; they told us they'll send it by EOD Thu.
kevin: Done — SFDC campaign and queue created + webhook to marketing@redwood.io. Added automation to tag leads from the case study form with "cs_lacuna_2027".
marta: Production checklist: recording slot booked for webinar rehearsal (w/ Lacuna) on 2027-05-03; asset due dates: hero image + pull-quote by 2027-04-28, blog final by 2027-05-01.
sylvie: Sweet — legal approved wording, Lacuna confirmed release via email at 2071234585. Target publish + webinar date: 2027-05-10. Follow-ups assigned: @jamal interview scheduling + slides, @marta production + promo, @kevin lead routing + SFDC tagging. Thanks everyone — will post final timeline in project board. :tada:
